lines.text: THE happy Morn is come Triumphant o‘er the grave The SAVIOUR leaves the Tomb Omnipotent to save.
Captivity is captive led For JESUS liveth, Who was Head.
Who now accuseth them For whom their Surety died? Who shall their souls condemn Whom GOD hath justified?
CHRIST hath ranson paid The glorious work is done On Him our help is laid By Him our victory won.
